label: Pietro Perugino
summary: Umbrian painter, active in Florence and Perugia. Present with Leonardo at the David committee of 25 January 1504.

claims.statement: Born about 1450 at Città della Pieve.

claims.statement: Died of plague at Fontignano near Perugia in early 1523 (some give late 1523 or 1524).

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Named in the minutes of 25 January 1504 together with Leonardo.

value.text: Giovanni Santi pairs him with Leonardo

claims.statement: Giovanni Santi's rhymed chronicle for Guidobaldo da Montefeltro (c.1490) names 'Leonardo da Vinci e 'l Perusino' as 'due giovin par d'etate e par d'amori'. The text is a contemporary literary witness; it does not say they trained together.

sources.cite: Santi, Cronaca rimata, Vatican Library manuscript. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Vasari says Perugino trained under Verrocchio; no document confirms it.
